mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The mechanism is active whenever the rate falls, regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 200.0, persistent inflation prompts aggressive Fed tightening, reducing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 200.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The interaction between both series is necessary for the signal.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (low unemployment), a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals an impending economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansion when UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening economic activity, reducing corporate profits and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days. The mechanism is active whenever INDPRO falls, regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeds 11300.0, strong economic expansion boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 > 11300.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL > 200.0 signals aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The interaction between both series is necessary for the signal.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL > 200.0, or the Rank IC for the interaction falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle recovery (high unemployment), a strong increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals improving labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during early-cycle recovery when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
